Home
Paradise Valley Unified School District

Welcome to the 

In PVSchools, we engage, inspire, and nurture students through high-quality instruction, meaningful educational opportunities, and dynamic learning experiences. These experiences make up the roadmap for each learner’s journey of excellence.

PVSchools provides advanced academic programs that nurture creativity, curiosity, and strategic thinking through dynamic learning experiences. From preschool to graduation, in PVSchools, every learner is empowered for a lifetime of success! 

Explore PVSchools

For every learner, there is a journey of excellence that begins in PVSchools. With a variety of opportunities, PVSchools offers families the luxury of choice in their child's education.

Center for Research, Engineering, Science, and Technology

CREST

CREST, a leader in STEM education, is a four-year Career and Technical Education STEM program offered at Paradise Valley High School that provides students with the opportunity to study one of three specialized disciplines; Bioscience, Computer Science, and Engineering.

North Valley Arts Academies

NVAA

An outlet for children with a passion for dance, theater, creative musicianship, and music technology or visual arts, NVAA offers a seamless continuation from elementary through high school. NVAA is the first fully integrated arts education program in the Northeast Valley.
